Compensation & Benefits Standards - array of { item, item_label, standard_code, standard_label, text, timePeriod? } objects, one per comp/benefit item the provision addresses. Each item gets its OWN standard - do NOT collapse to a single section-wide standard. Include `timePeriod` per item only when the agreement specifies a per-item period that differs from the headline protectionPeriod (e.g. severance keyed to a 24-month qualifying-termination window while salary tracks 12 months).
